audit_metadata.deliverable: Full Project Audit, Mobile-First UI/UX Repair, Defect Resolution, and Final APK Verification

priority_defects_and_resolutions.symptom: A RenderFlex overflowed by 3.7 pixels on the right in the calendar header row.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.root_cause: The month selector (< March 2025 >) containing DropdownButton with chevron (~160px intrinsic width) was placed side-by-side with navigation chevrons and attendance capsule (~150px) inside an unconstrained Row exceeding 329dp viewport card width.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.solution: Refactored header using LayoutBuilder: on viewports <350dp, month selector is given dedicated upper row and attendance capsule is rendered on second row; on wider displays, FittedBox scales capsule cleanly without clipping or overflow.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.test_evidence: Zero flutter analyze issues, flutter test suite passing, card renders cleanly at 320dp, 360dp, 400dp viewports.

priority_defects_and_resolutions.symptom: Attendance breakdown displayed an illegible ~8px smeared row of 42 overlapping 'P' letters, checkmarks, and period numbers 1..42, with misleading label '42 of 42 periods attended (100%)'.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.root_cause: Fallback logic iterated over the student's entire 6-day weekly timetable (6 days x 7 periods = 42 entries) without day-of-week filtering, and crammed all 42 entries into a single horizontal Row of Expanded widgets.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.solution:
1. Filtered timetable items by matching day-of-week (targetDay) to restrict entries strictly to the selected day's academic periods (max 7).
2. Replaced single unconstrained Row with responsive Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8) rendering cleanly styled status badges (P1, P2...).
3. Added compact visual status legend (Present, Absent, On-Duty, Scheduled).
4. Replaced fabricated '42 of 42 attended' string with truthful summary: displaying attendance count and percentage only when real attendance logs exist, or academic schedule status when unrecorded.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.test_evidence: Passes unit and widget tests, verified rendering on narrow viewports without overflow or overlapping characters.

priority_defects_and_resolutions.screen: Student Dashboard, Attendance Report, Timetable, Profile Screens
priority_defects_and_resolutions.symptom: The bottom cards, last attendance records, timetable items, and profile sign-out button were hidden or cut off behind the floating glass bottom navigation bar.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.root_cause: Scrollable bodies ended with standard 20-32px spacers. Floating navigation bar is 68px tall with 12px margins and 24px blur (effective height ~88px).
priority_defects_and_resolutions.solution: Enforced minimum 110px safe bottom clearance across all scrollable lists and Column views, ensuring every interactive element can be fully scrolled above the floating navigation bar.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.test_evidence: Verified across all 4 student screens in flutter test and layout inspection.

priority_defects_and_resolutions.symptom: AppBar actions and title collided on narrow screens causing RenderFlex right overflow; swipe hint collided with filter chips.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.root_cause: 3 IconButton actions with 38x38 min constraints and default padding consumed 114-144px, squeezing the title; swipe instructions were unconstrained alongside All and Unread filter chips.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.solution:
1. Optimized AppBar action constraints to 34x34 with 5px padding and 20px icons, leaving ample space for title.
2. Wrapped notification title in FittedBox(scaleDown).
3. Refactored filter bar swipe hint to concise 'Swipe: ⇦ delete • pin ⇨' inside Expanded with TextOverflow.ellipsis.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.test_evidence: Passes flutter analyze, zero overflow at 360dp width.

priority_defects_and_resolutions.defect_type: Dismissible Widget Tree Red Screen Crash
priority_defects_and_resolutions.symptom: Red crash screen: 'A dismissed Dismissible widget is still part of the tree.' upon swiping a notification.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.root_cause: Dismissible onDismissed attempted to mark item read or update pinned state without immediately removing the dismissed item from the notification list synchronously.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.solution: Configured confirmDismiss to return false on swipe-right (pin/unpin) so item remains in tree with state update, and return true on swipe-left (delete) while synchronously calling removeNotificationLocally in onDismissed.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.test_evidence: Verified in test/notification_delete_pin_test.dart and live on Samsung Galaxy S24.

priority_defects_and_resolutions.symptom: Deleted notifications reappeared whenever the inbox was refreshed, app reopened, or new page fetched.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.root_cause: Backend NotificationLog lacked is_deleted flag and soft-delete endpoints; deletion was previously memory-only on client.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.solution: Added is_deleted (Boolean, index=True) and deleted_at (DateTime) to NotificationLog. Created DELETE /api/v1/notifications/{id} endpoint and filtered all inbox/unread queries by is_deleted == False.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.test_evidence: pytest tests/test_notification_delete_pin_audit.py passed (soft delete persistence test passed).

priority_defects_and_resolutions.defect_type: Missing Pinned Notifications & Bulk Deletion Protection
priority_defects_and_resolutions.symptom: Important admin notifications could not be pinned, and bulk-clearing deleted pinned records.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.root_cause: NotificationLog schema had no pin support; bulk delete wiped all records without discrimination.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.solution: Added is_pinned (Boolean, index=True) and pinned_at (DateTime) columns. Added POST /pin and /unpin endpoints. Configured deterministic inbox sort: is_pinned.desc(), pinned_at.desc(), created_at.desc(). Bulk delete API and UI specifically preserve all pinned items.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.test_evidence: Deterministic sort tests passing; bulk delete preserves pinned items verified.

priority_defects_and_resolutions.symptom: Biometric enrollment character animation was static or had black silhouette/green fringe background artifacts.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.root_cause: Static PNG fallback was displayed or WebP frames were encoded with solid white background instead of genuine alpha channel transparency.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.solution: Extracted movement reference from vedio-ch.mp4 and appearance reference, generated 144-frame transparent WebP with genuine alpha channel, verified across white and dark surfaces, and integrated at top center above face capture guide.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.test_evidence: WebP verified on disk: 144 frames, alpha channel confirmed, smooth looping animation.

priority_defects_and_resolutions.defect_type: Light Theme Surface Illegibility & Saturated Glows
priority_defects_and_resolutions.symptom: Light theme had invisible card borders, white-on-white text in active filters, and dark neon blotches from liquid ambient canvas.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.root_cause: glassBorder used white opacity (0x80FFFFFF) invisible on cream background; ambient canvas rendered dark-mode saturated neon orbs regardless of theme.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.solution: Re-tokenized light theme to tactile warm sand/taupe borders (#E6DCD0 / #D5C8B8), soft warm cream ambient canvas diffusions, onPrimary active chip text, and preserved 100% of Obsidian Abyss dark theme visionOS styling.
priority_defects_and_resolutions.test_evidence: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant (7:1+ contrast), verified across all student, faculty, and admin screens.
